data.name: 100% Accurate Youtuber Simulator
data.detailed_description:
100% Accurate Youtuber Simulator is a single-player survival horror game set in an abandoned Japanese high school shrouded in mystery. Explore dark classrooms and hallways, uncover hidden clues, and survive against relentless enemies as you piece together the truth behind the disappearances.

You cannot fight back — your only hope is to run, hide, solve puzzles, and outsmart the figures that stalk you.

Gameplay Features

  • First-Person/Third-Person Survival Horror – Experience tense, atmospheric exploration with limited visibility and no weapons to defend yourself.

  • Flashlight & Battery Management – Keep your phone’s flashlight alive by collecting power banks. Without light, the dark figures become unstoppable.

  • Enemy Encounters – Multiple unique entities hunt you throughout the school. Some appear suddenly, while one relentless beast stalks you strategically, forcing you to stay alert at all times.

  • Puzzles & Clues – Unlock new areas of the school by solving environmental puzzles. Follow journal entries left behind by students, including one who nearly uncovered the truth before vanishing.

  • Exploration & Secrets – Search classrooms, offices, and hidden areas for notes, recordings, and environmental storytelling that reveal the dark history of Origashima High.

  • Progression & Replayability – Multiple endings based on your choices and discoveries. Will you simply survive the night, or uncover the school’s deepest secret?

  • Immersive Horror Experience – Designed for players who enjoy psychological horror, stealth gameplay, and mystery-driven exploration.

Key Details

  • Genre: Survival Horror / Psychological Horror

  • Perspective: First-Person / Third-Person

  • Modes: Single-player

  • Playtime: Approx. 3–5 hours per playthrough (with replayability for different endings)

  • Replay Value: Multiple endings and branching discoveries

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5/AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Device

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.5 Monterey
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core OR Apple M1
  • Sound Card: Built In Mac Audio
